component.name: Lunifier (No-BtSync Edition)
component.summary: Seamless Logitech Easy-Switch flow across Windows and Linux (Standalone)

description.p: Lunifier coordinates Logitech Easy-Switch keyboards and mice (MX Keys, MX Master series, M720 Triathlon, POP, etc.) across multiple screens without requiring a local Wi-Fi or LAN connection.
This standalone No-BtSync edition operates autonomously on your computer without inter-host Bluetooth RFCOMM communication.

ul.li: Hardware-level switching under 20ms using Logitech HID++ 2.0 protocol
Autonomous switching across Direct Bluetooth, Unifying, and Logi Bolt receivers
Per-monitor configurable border triggers and customizable active dwell zones
Double-touch border knock trigger to prevent accidental switching
Native GNOME GTK4 + Libadwaita user interface with system tray integration

screenshot.caption: Lunifier Settings and Monitor Border Configuration

description.p: Windows Store compliance updates, Linux system tray icon rendering fixes for GNOME AppIndicator, and multi-monitor border dwell reliability improvements.
